title: The One-Star Guest Who Became a Regular

scenes.speaker: Ivan
scenes.say: My latte was cold. One star.
Roma Tom could have argued. Instead he wrote back: you're right, I'm sorry, your next latte is on me.

props.caption: Roma Tom *writes back*
props.name: Ivan
props.text: Latte was cold and nobody noticed. One star.
props.reply: Ivan, you're right, and I'm sorry. Your next latte is on me. I'll make it myself.

scenes.speaker: Ivan
scenes.say: Fine. I'll try it once more. Okay, this one is actually hot.
One week, a hot latte. Two weeks, the same table. By month three, Ivan is in every Tuesday.
Then Ivan updates his review. Five stars. Cold latte once. The owner fixed it himself.

props.caption: Ivan *updates* his review
props.name: Ivan
props.text: Updated: cold latte once. The owner fixed it himself. Here every Tuesday now.
props.reply: See you Tuesday, Ivan. Extra hot.

scenes.say: Tag an owner who won a guest back. Follow for more cafe life.
